body.purpose: Keeps navigation, tables, controls, and report labels consistent.

label.purpose: Uses 10–12px semibold type for table headings, captions, and controls.

metric.purpose: Shows current totals without fabricated comparison trends.

shadows.name: surface-rest
shadows.purpose: Separates bordered panels from the cool slate canvas.

shadows.name: panel-hover
shadows.purpose: Adds restrained feedback to metric cards.

shadows.name: dialog-focus
shadows.purpose: Places a focused database form above the administration surface.

shadows.name: mobile-drawer
shadows.purpose: Separates the open navigation drawer from the page.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Provides brief feedback for hover, focus, and press states.

motion.name: loading
motion.purpose: Communicates active refresh or form submission.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The blue primary action for an administration task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--blue); color: #fff; font: 650 12px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Filters records in the active section and supports a keyboard shortcut.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg aria-hidden="true"></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Buscar en esta vista…"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; min-height: 39px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--muted); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #93b4fb; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring); } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: A current database-backed total with a compact semantic icon.
components.css: .ds-metric-card { display: flex; min-height: 118px; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 19px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); } .ds-metric-icon { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--blue-soft); color: var(--blue); }

components.name: Report Panel
components.description: Contains one chart, occupancy view, table, or operation module.
components.css: .ds-report-panel { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); color: var(--ink); } .ds-report-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-report-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Makes the selected admin section clear in the fixed navy rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: #1e3a5f; color: #fff; text-align: left; font: 650 13px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item svg { color: #93c5fd; }

components.name: Availability Status
components.description: Pairs explicit availability text with semantic emerald or red.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--green-soft); color: var(--green); font: 650 10px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A data-first console lets a restaurant manager scan current SQL-backed reports and open supported operations. Deep navy navigation anchors the interface, a slate canvas and white panels keep records legible, blue carries actions, and emerald/amber/red encode operational state. Current values remain distinct from date trends the source views do not provide.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent navy navigation with a responsive drawer.
Utility header with active-section search, database status, local date/time, refresh, and local administration context.
Current report data and tables stay in the user's scan path.
SVG line icons and text-paired semantic states remain consistent across modules.

rules.name: The State-Color Rule
rules.body: Blue means act; emerald means available; amber means review; red means unavailable or occupied. Color is paired with text.

rules.name: The Fact-First Rule
rules.body: Use current SQL-backed values and never invent KPI trends or authenticated identity.

dos: Do show database-backed values and distinct loading, empty, disconnected, and error states.
Do keep every action aligned with the supplied stored procedures.
Do preserve table detail when a chart is limited for scanability.
Do pair status color with explicit text.
donts: Don't invent KPI trends, user identity, or sample data.
Don't use amber for primary actions.
Don't hide table overflow by shrinking data labels beyond readability.
Don't expose the local administration server to a public network without authentication.
